title: 中信策略师Shirhali：中芯国际盈利强劲，国内供应链受益
speaker: Shirhali

segments.en: And not mention that Changshin, it has made 100 billion in the first half.
segments.zh: 更不用说中芯国际，上半年盈利1000亿。

segments.en: So, sorry, 50 billion in the first, 56 billion in the first half.
So for this year, the earnings should be around 100 billion or even higher.
segments.zh: 所以今年盈利应该在1000亿左右甚至更高。

segments.en: So with that amount of cash at hand, I won't be surprised if it started investing domestic equipment as well.
segments.zh: 手握如此现金，它开始投入国产设备我也不会惊讶。

segments.en: So the whole domestic supply chain would be the beneficiary of this new trend.
segments.zh: 整个国内供应链将成为这一新趋势的受益者。

segments.en: And not mention their evaluation has been quite attractive at this moment.
segments.zh: 而且目前它们的估值相当有吸引力。
